explanation: Proposition 3 itself asserts, without definition or proof, that a $GL_m$ character can be evaluated at the superspace $\mathbb{C}^{1|1}$ and that this annihilates exactly the non-hook Schur functors. That is precisely the reviewer’s objection: the plethystic/super-Schur interpretation and the recovery of the hook coefficients are unjustified in this block.
